name: nepali-age-calculator
description: Umer — a MERN family age calculator for Bikram Sambat (BS) and Gregorian (AD) dates.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w @umer/server" "npm run dev -w @umer/client"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w @umer/server" "npm run dev -w @umer/client -- --host"
